href.description: URL the clickable navigates to. Omit it to render a button instead of a link.

className.description: Additional layout or utility classes applied to the root anchor or button (e.g. 'flex-column padding-2').

id.description: Optional id attribute for the root element.

children.description: Composed content. React provides Clickable.Link, Clickable.ColorChange, and Clickable.BgColorChange; Django provides clickable_link, clickable_color_change, and clickable_bg_color_change block tags.
